Monetary policy decision June 2026

Published 17 June 2026

The decision in brief

The policy rate is left unchanged at 1.75 per cent, some probability that it will be raised later this year.

Inflation is low, but the risks of inflation becoming too high going forward have increased.

The Economic activity is somewhat weaker than normal, but the conditions are favourable for economic activity to strengthen.

Policy rate

1.75%

Applies from 24 June 2026

Decision documentation

Voting by the Executive Board on interest rate decisions xlsx 168.7 kB

Minutes of the Monetary Policy Meeting held on 16 June 2026 pdf 447.7 kB

Forecast for the policy rate

Policy rate, published on 17 June 2026

Figure: Policy rate and forecast in the short run June 2026.csv

The figure shows the outcomes for the policy rate (solid line) and the Riksbank’s forecast of the policy rate in the coming three quarters (dashed line). Outcomes are daily data and the forecast refer to quarterly average values. Read more about the forecast for the policy rate in the Monetary Policy Report . Source: The Riksbank.

Next monetary policy decision?

The next monetary policy meeting will take place on 19 August 2026 and information on the monetary policy decision, including the policy rate, will be communicated the day after, 20 August 2026 .
